subject.title: feat(apps): add native mobile Automations parity

question: Should native mobile Automations ship with this focused management subset while creation, cloning, and advanced delivery or failure routing remain Control-UI-only?
rationale: This is a substantial new native capability and the canonical issue deliberately defines a permanent cross-client product boundary; code evidence cannot authorize that choice.

options.title: Approve focused parity
options.body: Ship the proposed search, inspection, history, revision-safe mutation, and run controls after the stale-diagnostics defect and exact-head validation are resolved.

options.title: Narrow the first release
options.body: Land naming and discovery first, with additional iOS management controls split into separately approved work.

options.title: Keep management web-first
options.body: Retain advanced management in the Control UI and redesign or defer the native expansion.

recommendation.title: Approve focused parity
recommendation.body: Ship the proposed search, inspection, history, revision-safe mutation, and run controls after the stale-diagnostics defect and exact-head validation are resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history most strongly connects this person to recent cross-platform native management work, though another native-app owner should independently approve the boundary.
